mapper.select: SELECT e.drama_id AS drama_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.kind = 'start' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS plays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.kind = 'complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pe.kind = 'start' AND pe.created_at >= #{shortWindow} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hot FROM playback_events pe JOIN episodes e ON e.id = pe.episode_id WHERE pe.created_at >= #{longWindow} AND e.drama_id IN #{dramaId} GROUP BY e.drama_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playback_events WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND kind = #{kind}
SELECT DISTINCT episode_id FROM playback_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND kind = 'complete'
SELECT episode_id FROM entitlements WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND entitlement_type = 'coin'

SELECT dt.tag_id AS tag_id, pe.kind AS kind, pe.created_at AS created_at FROM playback_events pe JOIN episodes e ON e.id = pe.episode_id JOIN drama_tags dt ON dt.drama_id = e.drama_id WHERE pe.user_id = #{userId} AND pe.created_at >= #{cutoff}

SELECT dt.tag_id AS tag_id, r.created_at AS created_at FROM reactions r JOIN drama_tags dt ON dt.drama_id = r.target_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.target_type = 'drama' AND r.kind IN ('like', 'favorite') AND r.created_at >= #{cutoff}
SELECT target_id AS target_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM reactions WHERE target_type = 'drama' AND kind = 'like' AND target_id IN #{dramaId} GROUP BY target_id
SELECT episode_id AS episode_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM comments WHERE episode_id IN #{episodeId} AND status = 'approved' GROUP BY episode_id
SELECT * FROM subscriptions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' LIMIT 2
